title: AgriSell Rider Questionnaire
subtitle: Questions about your delivery work and what you need from the app

pages.heading: 1. Your vehicle and delivery work
pages.lead: For riders or delivery drivers. Answer from your own experience. There are no right or wrong answers. Write 'Not sure' or 'Not applicable' when needed. If you have not used AgriSell, skip questions about using it and answer based on your usual delivery work. Do not include account passwords, ID numbers or bank details.
